certified_facts: DRNA described a monitoring metric based on four USGS-operated sentinel wells for southern aquifers.
The four sentinel observation points are Aguirre in Salinas, Constancia in Ponce, Jac-6 in Juana Diaz, and Alomar Oeste in Santa Isabel.
All four sentinel labels are now bound to unique USGS site numbers.
USGS exposes parameter 72019, Water level depth below land-surface datum, for Constancia 3 and Jac-6.
The public-facing condition scale comprised optimal, observation, controls-and-adjustments, and critical states.
DRNA treated aquifer conditions separately from reservoir conditions.
Published weekly examples report depth below land surface, so larger depth values represent lower groundwater levels and parameter direction must be preserved.
not_certified: numeric threshold for each condition state
exact 2015 parameter-code binding for Aguirre and Alomar Oeste
raw 2014-2016 observation-byte denominator for the four sentinel points
records.epistemic_use: Certifies sentinel identities, USGS site bindings, qualitative operating-state vocabulary, and depth-direction semantics where parameter 72019 is explicit. Numeric thresholds and raw historical series remain unresolved.
